useWhen: Reviewing a skill's quality and completeness
Quality checking a newly built skill

workflow.description: Identify which skill to review, gather skill files (SKILL.md + references), understand purpose and scope
Verify skill has proper structure: required files present, links resolve, no placeholder text, proper formatting
Evaluate clarity (specific descriptions, clear triggers), completeness (edge cases, quality criteria), and methodology quality
For skills with schemas: check sections defined, required vs optional fields, validation rules, confidence tagging
Identify gaps by severity: Critical (missing files, incomplete schema), Major (vague descriptions, weak methodology), Minor (formatting issues)
Generate specific actionable recommendations: Fix Now (critical), Improve Later (major), Consider (nice-to-haves)
Output structured review report with skill name, overall assessment, detailed findings, and prioritized recommendations

examples.input: Review the competitor-research skill for quality
examples.output: Skill review report with structure check, quality scores, gap register, and prioritized recommendations
examples.context: Auditing existing skill before using in production

examples.input: Check if our new skill is properly built
examples.output: Quality assessment with identified gaps, missing elements, and fix recommendations
